scope: Global UN WUP 2025 city settlement ranks 1201–1300, with immutable source population values and Year=2025 PWCent coordinates.

source.organization: United Nations, Department of Economic and Social Affairs, Population Division
source.publication: World Urbanization Prospects: The 2025 Revision, Online Edition
source.populationField: Pop for Year=2025; units are thousands; ranking does not remove low-plausibility rows.
source.identity: City_Code is the WUP settlement identity; coordinates use the Year=2025 PWCent fields and are settlement points, not municipal boundaries or cadastral coverage claims. Some older normalized queue coordinates differ; e.g. Dighwara old point 25.969189,84.824243 vs this source point 25.9220863,84.8502742.

method.ranking: Sort all unique 2025 City_Code rows by Pop descending; numeric City_Code breaks equal-population ties.
method.exactAttempt: Exclude same-WUP-code registry and non-queue city-artifact attempts irrespective of outcome; apply confirmed root overlay decisions when WUP code and country match.
method.identityReview: Hold unresolved same-country name/alias matches for root identity decisions; do not place held settlements in the pending queue.
method.queueOnly: Queue membership alone is not an attempt; queued and pending artifacts are excluded from attempt evidence.
method.runtimeConfigs: All runtime city configurations were parsed and recorded as identity-review candidates; configuration presence alone is not treated as a city research attempt.
method.priorCapitalChecks: All 156 checked=true, previously_checked records in the 225-entry world-capitals roster are matched; exact WUP IDs count directly and same-country name/centroid aliases remain identity-review candidates.
method.scopeCaveat: WUP DEGURBA settlements can differ from municipalities and metropolitan governance units; review crosswalks before treating a match as identical.
method.rootOverlay: Read and apply the current root identity decision overlay by WUP City_Code and country. The newly reviewed Atlanta decision applies in this rank range; earlier crosswalk decisions are preserved.

attemptEvidence.reason: The earlier municipal Atlanta and Fulton County parcel investigation explicitly concerns the same city; a 5.14km population-weighted centroid difference does not make it a new city attempt. Both positive and unsuccessful prior investigations are excluded.
